subject: general
question: According to the Census of India 2011, which states of India have population density more than 1000 persons per sq. km?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar and West Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bihar:**

 
 
• Bihar had the highest population density among all Indian states in the 2011 Census.
 
• Its population density was 1,106 persons per sq. km.
